$description: What is known about each filament in palette.filament, for matching screen colours to real spools. The hex values in brand-inputs.json were sampled from photos, so they are approximate: lighting, white balance and the camera all move them. Until a spool is identified by manufacturer and colour code (and ideally measured with a colorimeter), treat the swatch as a reminder of the colour, not a specification. Fields marked TODO are for Jeremiah.

printer.model: TODO — HandCAD's docs reference a Bambu Lab A1 mini (180 × 180 × 180 mm bed); confirm that is the printer these filaments run on.
printer.nozzle: 0.4mm (assumed; brand/tokens/core/size.json → physical.* is sized for it)

light-gray.product: TODO (line and material, e.g. PLA Basic / PLA Matte / PETG)
light-gray.colourCode: TODO (SKU or colour code from the spool label)
light-gray.measuredLab: TODO (L*a*b* D50 from a colorimeter on a printed swatch, if available)
light-gray.notes: The body of most parts (65 % in mix a, 60 % in mix b).

orange.notes: The accent on a part: what you actuate (25 % in mix a, 10 % in mix b). 1.47:1 against light gray — never adjacent without a dark band or label.

space-gray.colourName: TODO ("space gray" is Jeremiah's name; confirm the manufacturer's)
space-gray.notes: Structure and chrome (30 % in mix b, or the 10 % in mix a).

black.notes: Edges, bands and markings: the colour that makes orange readable on light gray.

mixes.name: Mix a — light part, orange band
mixes.note: Orange and light gray sit one lightness step apart (1.47:1): the 10 % black outlines or labels the orange.

mixes.name: Mix b — light part, dark chrome, orange signal
mixes.note: Orange on space gray is 3.10:1 — fine for shapes and marks, not for text.
